name: crawlseo
description: Self-hosted SEO monitoring — Google Search Console, site crawler, Core Web Vitals, and an MCP server, in one dashboard.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions AND encrypts stored Google/DataForSEO credentials at rest.

CRON_SECRET.description: Bearer token that protects the /api/cron scheduler endpoint.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID (enable Search Console, URL Inspection, PageSpeed Insights APIs).

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public app URL, e.g. https://crawlseo.osc-fr1.scalingo.io (used for OAuth callbacks and by the scheduler).

GOOGLE_PAGESPEED_KEY.description: Optional: PageSpeed Insights API key for higher Core Web Vitals quota.
